22:30
Lucy
•

Yes, we do ship internationally—how exciting! We love sending our beautiful custom jewellery all over the world. Customs and duties are handled a bit differently depending on where you are:

For most European countries, import taxes and duties are included in the price, so you won’t have any extra charges when your order arrives.
For the USA, customers are responsible for customs duties and tariffs. There’s a new 30% tariff for US orders, and these charges go directly to the US government.
For the rest of the world, any customs charges are set by your local carrier and laws, and you’ll need to cover those yourself.

If you want all the details, you can check out our shipping policy here.
